[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/87e0d0237e4d7bed2e9998a9f898d7edd608b13a.png[/img]

CUSTOM SKINS!
In this update you have the ability to add a custom image wrap on your knife!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/835e7fe2eea25cfb785b0effc547e375c8a2500e.png[/img]

You can also add custom images onto the ZOMBIES! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/cf287b10a900a66d42d6786db40bfc1a4d7114f1.png[/img]

There are also achievements tied to your XP level and level 999 can be reached to get MAX level.

We also have several other changes!

- Fixed several bugs

notes.title: v1.3 October Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

I finally have an update to share with you all!
The update will be dropping around 9-10am EST Today on Windows Mac and Linux.

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
[strike]NEW[/strike] Returning mode ZOMBIES!

Just in time for Halloween!
The mode will have 2 maps on launch with 3 different classes to choose from, but the rules won't be the same from it's predecessor.

If you are looking for an experience similar to 2023 classic mode is your go to mode!
Classic mode is when you go around and shoot enemies like normal with no objective, actually your only objective is to not die, with an occasional blood round to shake things up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/78f0d71bc72f65ed02e2a7e55a61ee905f30c617.png[/img]

A NEW! mode has been added to zombies and it's name is Base Defense Mode. In this mode you have to protect a certain object on the map from ruin by the zombies! The mode is very intense, as you have to deal with hostile zombies and bombers that won't attack you... but WILL attack the objective, and when that dies, the game is over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/c44543d8032331f5648c5884fa19af127a971bf1.png[/img]

[b]CLASSES[/b]
Instead of the pick one weapon system in Bhop 2023, in Bhop 2026 you can pick a class to get 2 weapons. With all classes accomodating for different play styles.

SAMURAI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/439805be98b409d910efeceda19369f23899a1a5.png[/img]
For the people who prefer a melee style of combat, this one is for you! Be careful for the big Giant Zombies! You'll have to switch to your SMD (SMDeez) to kill them fast!

SABOTAGER
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/cadb482039131ab267e19dbc5bff82f29b135105.png[/img]
The Sabotager supplies fast paced fire with the AS-48 Assault rifle, along with a factory issue deagle to deal high amounts of damage when the AS rifle has to reload.

SLAYER
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/8599161dd093cc2d12edae00dd5019e194c07af5.png[/img]
For those people who like crazy shotgun action! Use the slayer class, being able to kill multiple enemies up close with the shotgun, and also comes along with a deagle for intense situations!

[b]ZOMBIE TYPES[/b]
That's not all that's new! NEW zombies have been added

BABY ZOMBIE
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/801323ea367471e93651433632724e2fbc93c184.png[/img]
An annoying little midget who is hard to hit, but can be killed quite easily.

ZOMBIE GIANT (Compared to a Normal Zombie)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/140380fb7ec29a71aa0d571e58ca13f47b1b9a05.png[/img]
This HUGE zombie is slow compared to the baby and the normal, but will dash out HUGE amounts of damage like his size! We recommend you take them out first.

The EXPLODER
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/5d6b665deca94f86ec3b65eb423040bf97aaf32f.png[/img]
Pretty Self-Explanatory, but when you are playing Base Defense Mode, this thing will always be on the offensive trying to take out your prized possesion! So always keep your eye out for them!

A lot of work has gone into the zombies mode and we hope you enjoy playing it!  We plan to add a co-op mode in the future!

Other NEW Content
- *NEW* Backrooms map for Singleplayer
- *NEW* Easter eggs
- Steam Achievements for the new easter eggs + zombies
- Added map filtering to the singleplayer menu to allow easy navigation to certain levels
- Hit "U" to hide  your UI, if you like to take cinematic photos or for other purposes.
- General bug fixes and stability improvements
- The version on the menu has been updated :)

That's it for the update!
As always reply to this forum post OR let me know on the discord (discord.gg/scuffedbhop) about game breaking bugs and I will release a patch pretty quickly depending on how bad the bugs are.
-shanaz

Hello Everyone!

Version 1.2 of *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GOTY EDITION releases later today! Here is a list of updates we have made.

notes.title: *NEW* SCUFFED UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
Hey all Scuffed Bhoppers!

Today I'm providing an in-depth look of all new content we're bringing to Bhop 2026, and legacy features that are returning!

First of all

THE CAMPAIGN

We have showed off a small snippet of the campaign so far and you guys seem to like it, so thanks for your feedback!

(Video of the snippet)
[previewyoutube=Fd_eP--fPhk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Here is a rundown of everything you could see in the trailer.

[u][b]Music Playing[/b][/u]
Before I get into Campaign Specific mechanics, let me briefly explain the new Music system.

In the game, there is no longer a music selector, instead on first start up you will be greeted with this screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/7acc5e31f8117991e4944993750712353ebb500f.png[/img]

We now have non PeePeePooPoo music for people that don't like it, but you can stick to listening to the classic PeePeePooPoo OST.

All songs are currently on shuffled all of the time, so you might have to SKIP to your favourite song.

The all new MUSIC PLAYER can do that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/fae632b7890133b7025a687eaa6c7dfd1313e7df.png[/img]
(dont mind the low quality ss)

Press "/" key to open the music player. It will show you the Song Name, Artist, and a Progress Bar of the way through the song. You can skip a song at any time by pressing "n".

If you guys want an option for full forwarding or rewinding 10 seconds let me know :)

I will make it so that you pick the volume on first start up, and it will automatically apply everytime you open the game, so you don't have to deal with opening settings everytime you open the game.

[u][b]Music Choices[/b][/u]
ALL SONGS FROM THE ORIGINAL BHOP SIMULATOR RETURN FOR 2026. This includes seasonal music such as the "Spooky" we had for Halloween 2021. However this will NOT include music we introduced for Limited Time Crossovers (we will have some of these in 2026)

[u][b]Campaign Management[/b][/u]
In the campaign you can have 3 SAVE SLOTS, so you can store different saves with different progresses. This is useful if you have multiple people playing the game on one PC, or you want to [strike]go back to get a different ending[/strike]

In the CAMPAIGN, you have 3 options.

- Start A New Game (will write to a new save) (only available if there is a free save slot)

- Load Specific Level ( This option for each level unlocks AFTER you have beaten it in the campaign)

- Load Save

We hope you are all excited as us to see the BHOP 2 CAMPAIGN!!!

[u][b]Tracking Objectives + Secrets[/b][/u]

We have added a UI for tracking current mission progress and secrets within a level.
Each campaign level has 3 DIFFERENT SECRETS TO FIND.

Some come in the form of a square that you run into to pick up. Some other ones come in the form of a complete different room that you get teleported to with something funny inside :)

You can toggle your objective view with "g". This brings up this menu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41634673/45e89ddcaaa5bcd1fcadd285b8bd66c84b4e01ac.png[/img]

It displays what you have to do to progress (no waypoints because the game is scuffed)
And also displays your secrets
(and yes there is an achievement for getting all of the secrets)

A sneak peak of next Dev log for BHOP 2026

- a working inventory system for the CAMPAIGN
- RACE MULTIPLAYER MODE
- more REMASTERED bhop 2023 maps

That's all for todays update.
Have any feedback? Let me know in the threads comments, everyone's feedback will help me shape this game into the perfect sequel for the already perfect game :)

Thanks for reading :)
- Shanaz
